kapak.alt: Where cVEMP and oVEMP are recorded

youtube.baslik: Can a sound in the ear produce a response in the neck? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: VEMP is not a hearing response but a muscle reflex that starts in the otolith organs: cVEMP reflects the saccule and inferior vestibular nerve and is recorded from the same-side sternocleidomastoid muscle, while oVEMP reflects the utricle and superior vestibular nerve and is recorded under the opposite eye. The two sides are compared with an asymmetry ratio whose upper limit varies by lab, usually reported between 30 and 45 percent.

VEMP is not a hearing response; it is an otolith-driven muscle reflex.
cVEMP mainly reflects the saccule and the inferior vestibular nerve.
It is recorded from the same-side sternocleidomastoid, a neck muscle.
oVEMP reflects utricle and superior vestibular nerve, recorded under the opposite eye.
The asymmetry upper limit varies by lab, usually 30 to 45 percent.
